    Args:
    module_path (str): The path to the module where the class is defined.
    class_name (str): The name of the class to check.
    expected_fields (Optional[Dict[str, Any]]): An optional dictionary containing expected fields and their values.

    Returns:
    bool: True if the class exists and matches the expected fields, False otherwise.
    """

        if expected_fields is not None:
